original_title: High Protein Broccoli Feta Bean Soup

sv.title: Broccoli, spenat & fetaost- soppa
sv.description: Broccoli, lök, vitlök och ett helt block fetaost rostas i ugnen och mixas sedan med spenat, cannellinibönor, keso, buljong och citron till en slät soppa. Toppas med dill.

en.title: Broccoli, Spinach and Feta Soup
en.description: Broccoli, onion, garlic and a whole block of feta are roasted in the oven, then blended with spinach, cannellini beans, cottage cheese, stock and lemon into a smooth soup. Topped with dill.
